exposure.definition: at least one high or medium materiality event in the 20 completed ticker trading sessions before the decision session
exposure.comparator: no high or medium materiality event in the prior 20 completed ticker trading sessions

estimand.metric: Brier improvement, where improvement is Brier(A) minus Brier(C)
estimand.interaction: mean(C-A Brier improvement | exposed) minus mean(C-A Brier improvement | comparator)
estimand.positive_direction: semantic configuration improves more under prior materiality exposure
